title: Decoded finite vertex list and its values
statement: Let $m,N$ be natural numbers and let $c$ be a perfect-matching code of order $m$. Decoding $c$ from the list of all elements of $\mathrm{Fin}(N)$ and taking the natural-number values of both endpoints in each pair gives the same list of pairs as decoding $c$ from $[0,1,\ldots,N-1]$.
